Why this result

These answers are estimates. Requirements come from each publisher's own page, and processor and graphics strength comes from PassMark benchmark scores, some of them estimated. They tell you how your hardware compares on paper. They cannot promise frame rates, and they do not check your operating system or free disk space.

Game and software logos and cover art belong to their owners. They are shown only to identify each title, and SyraTHS is not connected to or endorsed by any of these companies.

SyraTHS does not sell laptops, and it earns nothing when you click a store link. Buy buttons go to the store's own page or a search for that model. No ads and no tracking. Signing in is optional.
